g.text: Jev 1.13.0: a fixed floor plus a per-token cost; options are just tokens
Every request sequential on one connection, conditions interleaved; the server's own upstream time (x-envoy-upstream-
service-time), network excluded. Options (K=2 to 255, unique text every request) fall on the same line as state tokens:
no cache, no window, no batching wait.
